whatWasAdded: an independent reproduction through the CLI instead of the market UI: dsh plugin add dsh-review-outbox@0.1.8 writes minimumReleaseAgeExclude, and remove leaves the line behind while package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml are clean
a cleanup suggestion wider than matching installed packages: drop exclusion entries whose published version is already older than the release-age window, since they are no-ops from then on
the author-facing confusion this creates: add <name> resolves the highest matured version while add <name>@<version> bypasses the window through that same exclusion entry
whyThisBelongsThere: the repository's open issues are where DSH plugin operators read; the finding is reproducible in three commands and names no product of ours
evidenceSource: docs/OPERATIONS.md sections 1-2, measured the same night
